test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 13 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the word that is similar in meaning (SYNONYM) to the word given below.**

Efficacy
solution:
The correct answer is** 2) Efficiency.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**efficacy**" refers to** the ability or effectiveness of achieving a desired result or producing a desired effect**. It suggests the capability or power of something to bring about a successful outcome.

 
 
• For example, if a medicine has high efficacy, it means it is effective in treating a particular condition. 
 
 
 
• On the other hand, "**efficiency**" is **the quality or state of being efficient, which means achieving maximum productivity with minimum wasted effort or resources**. It implies the ability to accomplish tasks or goals in a timely and effective manner. For instance, if a process or system is efficient, it means it is well-organized and optimized for productivity.
 
• Example sentence using "**efficacy**":
 
 
• The **efficacy **of the new cleaning product in removing stains was impressive.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is** 2) Efficiency**, which is a synonym of "**efficacy**" as it implies effectiveness, productivity, and accomplishing tasks with minimal wastage.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1) Impotence **means powerlessness or inability to take action or achieve results. It is the opposite of efficacy and does not have a similar meaning.
 
• **Option 3) Ineptness** refers to a lack of skill or competence. It is not synonymous with efficacy as it suggests incompetence or inability rather than effectiveness.
 
• **Option 4) Futility **means the state of being pointless, useless, or ineffective. It is opposite in meaning to efficacy and does not share a similar meaning.
